caption: Smart agriculture concepts propose integrating artificial intelligence into farming workflows to assist daily management. These theoretical frameworks explore how computer vision and sensor data might help monitor crop health and soil moisture more efficiently. By processing large datasets, automated systems could potentially support farmers in making informed irrigation and resource allocation choices. While many of these digital tools remain in development or early testing phases, they represent a growing area of agricultural research. Understanding these emerging technologies helps stakeholders evaluate their future potential without assuming universal deployment. How might data-driven tools shape tomorrow's farms? #SmartAgriculture #AgTech #FutureFarming #AI #AgriTech
